atoms.text: Eine Mindmap eignet sich besonders gut, wenn man viele Informationen miteinander verknüpfen möchte.

instruction.text: Lies den folgenden Artikel über das Great Barrier Reef.
instruction.sound: Lies den folgenden Artikel über das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>Great Barrier Reef.</voice>

atoms.text:
Threats to The Great Barrier Reef

The Great Barrier Reef is one of the most biodiverse ecosystems in the world, but it is under extreme threat. Through overfishing and pollution, humans have a very big impact on the danger that all marine life is in. The biggest problem, however, is human induced CO2 emissions causing climate change. One consequence of this is the warming of the oceans, which has led to coral bleaching, a phenomenon in which corals lose their bright colours and develop diseases. In the long run, this can lead to coral reefs becoming uninhabitable. In addition, rising temperatures reduce the availability of nutrients, which threatens the survival of marine life that depends on the reef. All these factors greatly endanger the marine life in the Great Barrier Reef extremely.

instruction.text: Lies den folgenden Tagebucheintrag von Maya.

atoms.text:
04/22/2023

It’s all so unfair! I wanted to go on a camping trip with my friends next week. I haven't been on holidays for two years and have been REALLY looking forward to finally spending some time with my friends outside of school. But yesterday the worst happened: I broke my mobile phone, and now I need to save up for a new one. In the long run, a new mobile phone seems more important to me than a holiday .... The problem is that we can’t postpone our camping trip because the others don’t have time during the summer holidays. It's all so annoying because I love camping! And now Annika is mad at me because I might back out at short notice, and we had this HUGE fight. Why doesn't she understand that it isn't my fault at all? Maybe there's no point anyway if she's mad at me, then the whole holiday won't be any fun. What should I do?
